name: Jiren Ads - Click Tracker

nodes.name: Mongo: increment clicks
nodes.notes: Use a Mongo update with {$inc:{clicks:1},$set:{last_click:now}} on {code: c}. If your n8n MongoDB node can't express $inc directly, replace this node with a 'Code' node running a mongodb client update, or an HTTP request to a tiny increment endpoint.

_README: WHAT THIS DOES: a click-tracking redirect that runs SIDE-BY-SIDE with the bot.
Flow: user clicks https://YOUR-N8N-HOST/webhook/r?c=CODE  ->  increments click_links.clicks  ->  302-redirects to the real target_url.
1) Import this JSON into n8n. Set a MongoDB credential (same DB as the bot) on both Mongo nodes (replace REPLACE_MONGO_CRED_ID).
2) The bot writes docs to the 'click_links' collection: {code, user_id, target_url, clicks:0}.
3) The bot turns the advertiser's link into https://YOUR-N8N-HOST/webhook/r?c=CODE inside ads.
4) Set N8N_TRACK_BASE in the bot's .env to https://YOUR-N8N-HOST/webhook/r so it generates matching links.
NOTE: if your n8n MongoDB node version can't do $inc, swap 'Mongo: increment clicks' for a Code node that runs an update with {$inc:{clicks:1}}.
